sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，人们在加州的一处葡萄园里发现了一具女性尸体。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她被斩首，且体内的血已被抽干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 看来她的凶手费尽心机来隐瞒她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，人们只知道她叫无名氏。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 接着，侦探们终于知道了她的名字叫阿达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 但是，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《阿达》是“档案室呈现”推出的全新系列，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: The night of Friday, October 3, 2008, Canadian couple Trevor and Marissa were out walking their dog in the quiet suburban district of Mill Woods in Edmonton South.
sentences.zh: 2008年10月3日，星期五的晚上，一对加拿大夫妇特雷弗和玛丽莎在埃德蒙顿南部米尔伍兹安静的住宅区遛狗。

sentences.en: Suddenly, a young, dark-haired man staggered into their path from the direction of a nearby alleyway.
sentences.zh: 突然，一个年轻的黑发男子从附近的一条小巷方向踉踉跄跄地闯入了他们的视线。

sentences.en: He was hunched over, his shirt was torn, and he had a large whelped on his sweaty face.
sentences.zh: 他驼着背，衬衫破了，汗津津的脸上肿起了一个大包。

sentences.en: He collapsed and rolled around in what the couple thought was an overly theatrical manner, then stood up and screamed,
sentences.zh: 他瘫倒在地，在夫妇俩看来，他的举动有些过于夸张了，随后他站起身来尖叫道：

sentences.en: There's a guy attacking me.
sentences.zh: 有人在袭击我。

sentences.en: He's mugging me.
sentences.zh: 他在抢劫我。

sentences.en: Please help me.
sentences.zh: 请救救我。

sentences.en: He cried out,
sentences.zh: 他大喊大叫：

sentences.en: That's the guy, as a second hooded man wearing a black hockey mask with gold markings emerged from the alleyway.
sentences.zh: 就是那个人，这时第二个戴着带有金色标记的黑色曲棍球面具的连帽男子从巷子里走了出来。

sentences.en: The man tapped his mask as though to adjust it, then slipped behind a fence.
sentences.zh: 那名男子拍了拍面具，好像在调整它，然后溜到了一处栅栏后面。

sentences.en: He peered over the top and called out to the injured man.
sentences.zh: 他探出头去看着栅栏上方，朝着那个受伤的男子大喊。

sentences.en: Come on, Frank.
sentences.zh: 得了吧，弗兰克。

sentences.en: Come back.
sentences.zh: 回来吧。

sentences.en: Though he sounded light-hearted and friendly, Trevor and Marissa felt uneasy.
sentences.zh: 尽管他的语气轻松友好，但特雷弗和玛丽莎还是感到有些不安。

sentences.en: Suspecting the scenario was a set-up to mug them, the couple hurried away as the dishevelled stranger cried out,
sentences.zh: 这对夫妇怀疑这只是一场抢劫他们的阴谋，于是在那个衣衫褴褛的陌生人大声呼喊时匆忙离去：

sentences.en: Can you at least help me get to my car?
sentences.zh: 你们至少能帮我走到车边吗？

sentences.en: Trevor wanted the help, but couldn't shake his suspicion that it was a trap.
sentences.zh: 特雷弗很想帮忙，却又无法摆脱这可能是一个陷阱的怀疑。

sentences.en: He and Marissa rushed home, where they called the police.
sentences.zh: 他和玛丽莎急忙赶回家，并在那里报了警。

sentences.en: Officers were dispatched to the alleyway, but the two men were gone, and nothing seemed out of the ordinary.
sentences.zh: 警察被派往那条小巷，但那两个男人已经不见了，一切看起来都很正常。

sentences.en: They monitored the situation over the coming days, but received no word from the alleged victim, or further sightings of the assailant in the hockey mask.
sentences.zh: 他们在接下来的几天里密切关注着局势，但没有接到所谓受害者的任何消息，也没有再看到那个戴着曲棍球面具的袭击者。

sentences.en: Thirty-eight-year-old Johnny Altinger lived alone in his small apartment in Edmonton,
sentences.zh: 38岁的约翰尼·阿尔廷格独自住在埃德蒙顿的一间小公寓里，

sentences.en: where he was employed as a pipeline worker for oilfield equipment manufacturer Argus Machine.
sentences.zh: 他在那里受雇于油田设备制造商阿古斯机械公司，担任管道工人。

sentences.en: His night shifts were spent in quality control, a job he neither loved nor hated, but which gave him satisfaction.
sentences.zh: 他的夜班时间都花在质量控制上，这份工作他谈不上热爱也谈不上讨厌，但能带给他满足感。

sentences.en: Although they lived in different cities, he remained close with both his mother,
sentences.zh: 尽管他们住在不同的城市，但他与母亲阿尔弗雷达以及哥哥加里依然保持着密切的关系，并且有一群关系紧密的朋友，其中有些人甚至可以追溯到小学时代。

sentences.en: Alfreda, and his older brother, Gary, and had a close-knit group of friends, some of whom stretched back to grade school.
sentences.zh: 阿尔弗雷达

sentences.en: They described Johnny as good-natured, light-hearted, generous, thoughtful, quiet, and affectionate,
sentences.zh: 他们将约翰尼描述为一个性格随和、生性乐观、慷慨大方、体贴入微、性格安静且充满温情的人，

sentences.en: with an optimistic outlook that he used to help others adopt a more positive attitude in their own lives.
sentences.zh: 他总是抱着乐观的心态，并用这种态度去帮助他人以更积极的视角看待自己的生活。

sentences.en: Johnny had a number of hobbies, but the two that drew most of his attention were motorbikes and computers.
sentences.zh: 约翰尼有很多爱好，但最吸引他注意力的两样是摩托车和电脑。

sentences.en: He owned two bikes, a Honda 500cc and a Yamaha 1200cc sport touring bike.
sentences.zh: 他拥有两辆摩托车，一辆是本田500cc，另一辆是雅马哈1200cc运动旅行摩托。

sentences.en: His free time was spent going on rides, playing paintball, dabbling in new-age spirituality, and enjoying the music of Elton John.
sentences.zh: 他的空闲时间都用来骑车兜风、玩真人CS、涉猎新时代灵性知识，以及欣赏埃尔顿·约翰的音乐。

sentences.en: At age 12, Johnny begged his mother to buy him a Commodore 64, an 8-bit home computer, sparking what would become a lifelong passion.
sentences.zh: 在12岁时，强尼恳求母亲给他买了一台康多禄64，这是一款8位家用电脑，点燃了他一生对计算机的热情。

sentences.en: From then on, he was an early adopter of computing tech, constantly upgrading his systems through the various hardware and software iterations.
sentences.zh: 从那时起，他便成为了计算机技术的早期尝鲜者，随着硬件和软件的不断迭代，他的系统也在不断升级。

sentences.en: He was always willing to help out his less tech-savvy friends and family, with his brother, Gary Altinger, stating,
sentences.zh: 他总是乐于帮助那些对技术不太懂的朋友和家人，他的兄弟加里·阿尔廷格曾说：

sentences.en: Countless times he would sacrifice his own responsibilities to rescue me by word-processing term papers, essays, and other important assignments while I was attending university.
sentences.zh: 无数次，他为了帮我修改期末论文、文章和其他重要作业，宁愿牺牲自己的时间，在我上大学期间施以援手。

sentences.en: I owe much of my academic success to John.
sentences.zh: 我的学业能取得这么大的成功，很大程度上要归功于约翰。

sentences.en: Johnny made many online friends, who eventually became his friends in real life too, and by his 30s he was participating in online dating.
sentences.zh: 强尼结交了许多网友，他们最终也成为了现实生活中的朋友，到了30多岁时，他开始尝试网络交友。

sentences.en: He joined the two most popular free sites at the time, Plenty of Fish and Lava Life, and went on several dates of varying success,
sentences.zh: 他加入了当时最流行的两个免费交友网站——Plenty of Fish和Lava Life，约会过几次，结果各不相同，

sentences.en: while remaining optimistic that he'd find his perfect match someday.
sentences.zh: 但他依然保持乐观，相信总有一天能找到自己的灵魂伴侣。

sentences.en: On Plenty of Fish, Johnny connected with a 35-year-old woman named Jen, who sought fun times.
sentences.zh: 在Plenty of Fish上，强尼结识了一位35岁的女子名叫简，她寻求的是轻松快乐的时光。

sentences.en: Her profile pictures depicted an attractive woman in a bikini, although Johnny was aware that photos could be misleading.
sentences.zh: 她的资料照片显示是一位穿着比基尼的迷人女性，尽管强尼也知道照片可能会具有欺骗性。

sentences.en: Banter between the pair indicated they were a good match, and they organised a date for the night of Friday, October 10, 2008.
sentences.zh: 两人之间的调侃表明他们很合得来，于是他们约好在2008年10月10日星期五的晚上进行约会。

sentences.en: Jen didn't provide a street address for their meet-up, instead giving precise, turn-by-turn directions to a set location a 10-minute drive away from Johnny's apartment.
sentences.zh: 简没有提供约会地点的具体街道地址，而是给出了详细的路线指引，要他去一个距离强尼公寓车程10分钟的指定地点。

sentences.en: She had written,
sentences.zh: 她写道：

sentences.en: Although this sounds exciting, I have to make sure you're not some kind of weirdo, and so far you seem to be fairly well put together.
sentences.zh: 虽然这听起来很刺激，但我得确保你不是什么怪胎，而且到目前为止，你看起来还算靠谱。

sentences.en: But anyone can lie online.
sentences.zh: 但谁都能在网上撒谎。

sentences.en: Jen instructed Johnny to park in the driveway that looks like a forest, and sneak through a partially open garage door, making sure to press a button to close it behind him.
sentences.zh: 简指示强尼把车停在那个看起来像树林的私家车道上，然后悄悄穿过一扇半开着的车库门，并确保按一下按钮把身后的门关上。

sentences.en: She explained that a blanket would be spread out on the floor, as a friend was using the space as a workshop that weekend.
sentences.zh: 她解释说，地上会铺一条毯子，因为有个朋友周末正把这个空间当车间用。

sentences.en: By following her directions, Jen would be able to see Johnny before letting him into the house.
sentences.zh: 按照她的指引，简就能在让强尼进屋之前先看到他。

sentences.en: Quote,
sentences.zh: 引述如下：

sentences.en: On a lighter note though, If we really get on.
sentences.zh: 不过轻松点说，如果我们真的很合得来。

sentences.en: You said you had four days off.
sentences.zh: 你说过你休假四天。

sentences.en: How long can I keep you for if I choose?
sentences.zh: 如果我愿意，我可以留你多久？

sentences.en: Maybe you should pack for a few days.
sentences.zh: 也许你应该收拾几天的行李。

sentences.en: LOL.
sentences.zh: 哈哈。

sentences.en: Jen.
sentences.zh: 简。

sentences.en: Shortly before he left for his date,
sentences.zh: 就在他出发去约会前不久，

sentences.en: Johnny phoned his long-time trusted friend, Dale Smith.
sentences.zh: 强尼给他的多年好友戴尔·史密斯打了个电话。

sentences.en: Dale thought the messages from Jen were suspicious, and joked that Johnny should call him once he got there to let him know he was safe.
sentences.zh: 戴尔觉得简发的信息有点可疑，并开玩笑说强尼到了之后应该给他打个电话报平安。

sentences.en: When Johnny arrived at the garage a short time later, he was met by a friendly and jovial man who explained he was using the location to direct filMs.
sentences.zh: 不久后，当强尼到达那个车库时，迎面走来一位热情开朗的男子，对方解释说他正在利用这个地点拍摄电影。

sentences.en: He showed Johnny around the set where he was currently making a movie about a serial killer, and let him hold a fake gun that was among various prop weapons on a metal table.
sentences.zh: 他带着强尼参观了他目前正在拍摄的一部关于连环杀手电影的片场，还让他拿了一把金属桌上各种道具枪中的假枪。

sentences.en: The man told Johnny that Jen had been held up in traffic and didn't know what time she would be back.
sentences.zh: 那名男子告诉强尼，简遇到了交通堵塞，不知道什么时候才能赶回来。

sentences.en: Disappointed, Johnny headed home and called Dale, recounting the failed date in his typical light-hearted manner.
sentences.zh: 强尼感到有些失望，便开车回了家并给戴尔打了电话，用他一贯轻松幽默的语气讲述了这次失败的约会。

sentences.en: Shortly after Johnny hung up,
sentences.zh: 在强尼挂断电话后不久，

sentences.en: Dale received an email message from his friend that read,
sentences.zh: 戴尔收到了一条来自他朋友的电子邮件，上面写着：

sentences.en: She's home now.
sentences.zh: 她现在到家了。

sentences.en: I'm heading over again.
sentences.zh: 我正赶过去。

sentences.en: Eager to hear the outcome of the date,
sentences.zh: 急于想知道约会结果的戴尔，

sentences.en: Dale left numerous messages for Johnny on voicemail and text, but he didn't respond to any.
sentences.zh: 给强尼留下了无数条语音留言和短信，但他一条都没有回复。

sentences.en: Dale hoped that it had gone better than expected and his friend just didn't have time to reply.
sentences.zh: 戴尔希望事情进展得比预期顺利，只是他的朋友刚好没时间回复。

sentences.en: By Sunday, his enthusiasm turned to concern when Johnny failed to meet for a scheduled motorbike lesson.
sentences.zh: 到了周日，当约翰尼未能按约定去上摩托车课时，他的热情变成了担忧。

sentences.en: Friends often quipped that Johnny was so reliable you could set your watch by him and it was completely out of character for him to simply not show up without explanation.
sentences.zh: 朋友们经常开玩笑说，约翰尼可靠得可以拿他来对表，不解释一声就爽约完全不是他的作风。

sentences.en: On Monday morning, Dale finally received an email from Johnny that read,
sentences.zh: 周一早上，戴尔终于收到了一封来自约翰尼的电子邮件，上面写着：

sentences.en: I've met an extraordinary woman named Jen who has offered to take me on a nice, long, tropical vacation.
sentences.zh: 我遇到了一位非凡的女性，名叫珍，她邀请我去进行一次美好、漫长热带度假。

sentences.en: We'll be staying in her winter home in Costa Rica, phone number to follow soon.
sentences.zh: 我们将住在她位于哥斯达黎加的冬日住宅里，电话号码稍后会发给你们。

sentences.en: I won't be in town until December 10, but I will be checking my email periodically.
sentences.zh: 我直到12月10日才会回城，但我会定期查看电子邮件。

sentences.en: Dale was stunned.
sentences.zh: 戴尔惊呆了。

sentences.en: Johnny would never skip work to take an impromptu holiday, and he didn't like warm destinations, once returning from a trip to Hawaii complaining of the heat.
sentences.zh: 约翰尼绝不会为了说走就走的假期而翘班，而且他不喜欢炎热的目的地，曾经有一次从夏威夷旅行回来后直抱怨太热。

sentences.en: Dale knew if Johnny was truly leaving, it would take a few minutes to call, if only to ask Dale to store his beloved motorbikes.
sentences.zh: 戴尔知道，如果约翰尼真的要离开，至少会花几分钟打个电话，哪怕只是请戴尔帮忙照看他心爱的摩托车。

sentences.en: Furthermore, Johnny never signed off emails with his name, preferring to finish with a wisecrack about his friend.
sentences.zh: 此外，约翰尼的电子邮件从不用全名署名，他更喜欢用一句关于朋友的俏皮话来结尾。

sentences.en: Believing Johnny did not author the message,
sentences.zh: 戴尔确信这封信并非出自约翰尼之手，

sentences.en: Dale tested the sender by responding with a query, asking who would pick up Johnny's brother from the airport when he came to visit.
sentences.zh: 于是发问试探发件人，问当约翰尼的弟弟来访时，谁去机场接他。

sentences.en: Gary wasn't actually coming, and Johnny would know this, but Dale didn't get a reply.
sentences.zh: 加里其实并没有来，约翰尼是知道这一点的，但戴尔没有收到回复。

sentences.en: Other friends had also received the abrupt farewell email from Johnny.
sentences.zh: 其他朋友也收到了这封来自约翰尼的、语气突兀的告别邮件。

sentences.en: Each replied asking him to get in touch, but none heard back.
sentences.zh: 每个人都回复让他联系大家，但谁也没有收到回音。

sentences.en: Like Dale, one was suspicious as to who had sent the email, as Johnny usually called her sunshine, and the message was missing his telltale signs,
sentences.zh: 和戴尔一样，其中一人也怀疑这封邮件是谁发出的，因为约翰尼通常叫她“阳光”，而邮件中缺少了他的标志性特征，

sentences.en: including the joke or smiley face he ended their correspondence with.
sentences.zh: 包括他用来结束信件的笑话或笑脸。

sentences.en: That same day, an update appeared on Johnny's Facebook page that read,
sentences.zh: 就在同一天，约翰尼的脸书页面上更新了一条动态：

sentences.en: John is taking off to the Caribbean for a few months.
sentences.zh: 约翰去加勒比海待几个月。

sentences.en: See you all when I get back.
sentences.zh: 等我回来再见大家。

sentences.en: His relationship status was also changed to, in a relationship.
sentences.zh: 他的感情状态也被改成了“恋爱中”。

sentences.en: That evening, Johnny's boss received an email from him that read,
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，约翰尼的老板收到了一封来自他的邮件，上面写着：

sentences.en: Greetings.
sentences.zh: 问候。

sentences.en: While I've certainly enjoyed my time at Argus, I have another offer that is just too good to pass up.
sentences.zh: 虽然我很享受在阿尔古斯度过的时光，但我收到了另一个好得无法拒绝的offer。

sentences.en: So this is my notice that I will no longer be continuing my employment with your fine organisation.
sentences.zh: 所以在此通知贵公司，我将不再继续受雇于贵优秀机构。

sentences.en: I thank you for the opportunity, and rest assured, I would not be leaving unless this new path I've chosen was truly life-altering.
sentences.zh: 感谢您提供的机会，请放心，如果不是因为我选择的新道路确实能改变人生，我是不会离开的。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: John Altinger
sentences.zh: 约翰·奥尔廷格

sentences.en: There was no further contact from Johnny over the following days.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的几天里，约翰尼再也没有与外界联系。

sentences.en: His boss wrote back to him,
sentences.zh: 他的老板回信写道：

sentences.en: John, there are many rumours floating around about what you have run off to do.
sentences.zh: 约翰，关于你急急忙忙跑去干什么，外面流言四起。

sentences.en: All I need to know is where to forward your last cheque.
sentences.zh: 我只需要知道把你的最后一张支票寄到哪里。

sentences.en: Good luck in your endeavours, wherever they may be.
sentences.zh: 祝你在新的尝试中一切顺利，无论你在哪里。

sentences.en: Johnny ignored the message, and his $1,500 final paycheck went uncollected.
sentences.zh: 约翰尼忽视了这条消息，他那1500美元的最后薪水也没有人去领。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, his MSN messenger status changed to,
sentences.zh: 与此同时，他的MSN状态改成了：

sentences.en: I've got a one-way ticket to heaven, and I'm never coming back.
sentences.zh: 我买了一张通往天堂的单程票，而且我再也不会回来了。

sentences.en: And his Facebook page was updated once more to say,
sentences.zh: 他的脸书页面再次更新：

sentences.en: John is wondering why anyone would leave sun and surf to come home to snow and stress.
sentences.zh: 约翰想知道为什么会有人离开阳光和冲浪，回家面对冰雪与压力。

sentences.en: Carrie Lynn Souza was the wife of one of Johnny's friends.
sentences.zh: 嘉莉·林·索萨是约翰尼的一位朋友的妻子。

sentences.en: Although she had never met him, she decided to reach out to Johnny over Facebook in an effort to assist his friends.
sentences.zh: 尽管她从未见过他，但为了帮助约翰尼的朋友们，她决定通过脸书联系他。

sentences.en: In a private message, she wrote,
sentences.zh: 她在私信中写道：

sentences.en: Hi John, please respond as soon as you get this, or at least call Dale.
sentences.zh: 嗨，约翰，看到这个请马上回复，或者至少给戴尔打个电话。

sentences.en: Everyone is concerned for you.
sentences.zh: 大家都为你担心。

sentences.en: Thanks, Carrie Lynn.
sentences.zh: 谢谢，嘉莉·林。

sentences.en: Surprisingly, she received a prompt reply that read,
sentences.zh: 让人意外的是，她很快收到了回复，上面写着：

sentences.en: No need to be worried.
sentences.zh: 没必要担心。

sentences.en: I'm on vacation and loving it.
sentences.zh: 我在度假，而且很享受。

sentences.en: The internet is much easier to use than phones, due to terrible reception and coSt.
sentences.zh: 由于信号太差且费用高昂，用网络比用手机方便得多。

sentences.en: I just need to get away for a while, and I'm with someone wonderful.
sentences.zh: 我只是需要离开一会儿，我和一个很棒的人在一起。

sentences.en: I'll try to get in touch with Dale as soon as possible.
sentences.zh: 我会尽快尝试联系戴尔。

sentences.en: But in the meantime, let him know I'm having the time of my life.
sentences.zh: 但在此期间，请让他知道我正在过着我一生中最快乐的时光。

sentences.en: Carrie Lynn provided Johnny with a call collect phone number he could reach Dale on, and told him to ring by 6.30pm, or they would be following up with Edmonton City Police.
sentences.zh: 嘉莉·林给约翰尼留了一个对方付费的电话号码，让他可以打给戴尔，并告诉他必须在晚上6点30分之前打来，否则他们将报警求助埃德蒙顿市警察局。

sentences.en: When the call never came, the police were alerted, but they weren't overly concerned.
sentences.zh: 当电话始终没有打来时，警方接到了报警，但他们并没有表现出过分担忧。

sentences.en: They accepted Johnny's explanation that he had gone on holiday with a woman he had met online.
sentences.zh: 他们接受了约翰尼的解释，即他和在网上认识的女人去度假了。

sentences.en: Unconvinced,
sentences.zh: 心存疑虑的

sentences.en: Johnny's friends decided to break into his apartment to search for clues.
sentences.zh: 约翰尼的朋友们决定撬开他的公寓寻找线索。

sentences.en: They arrived at Johnny's four-storey condo, where his motorcycle sat uncovered in the outdoor parking lot of the complex.
sentences.zh: 他们来到了约翰尼所在的四层公寓，他的摩托车没有盖车衣，就停在大楼的室外停车场里。

sentences.en: His red Mazda 323 was missing.
sentences.zh: 他红色的马自达323不见了。

sentences.en: They broke a window to gain access to Johnny's apartment, finding dirty dishes in the sink, a paintball gun resting on his unmade bed,
sentences.zh: 他们砸碎窗户进入约翰尼的公寓，发现水槽里有脏盘子，未整理的床上放着一把彩弹枪，

sentences.en: an open CD case on the white leather couch in the lounge room, his motorcycle jacket hung over the back of a kitchen chair, and his helmet on the table.
sentences.zh: 客厅的白色皮沙发上放着一个打开的CD盒，椅背上挂着他的摩托车夹克，桌上放着他的头盔。

sentences.en: The mess itself wasn't unusual, as Johnny was known to tidy up when he expected guests.
sentences.zh: 这乱七八糟的景象本身并不寻常，因为众所周知约翰尼在预期有客来访时会打扫卫生。

sentences.en: Yet, the overall state of the apartment did not correlate with a person who had gone on holiday for an extended period of time.
sentences.zh: 然而，公寓的整体状况与一个出远门度假很长时间的人不符。

sentences.en: Johnny's laptop was missing, and strangely, so was his printer.
sentences.zh: 约翰尼的笔记本电脑不见了，奇怪的是，他的打印机也不见了。

sentences.en: In a surprise discovery, a desk drawer contained his passport, confirming he could not have gone to Costa Rica.
sentences.zh: 令人惊讶的是，他们在书桌抽屉里发现了他的护照，这证实了他不可能去了哥斯达黎加。

sentences.en: The group returned to the Edmonton Police with the evidence they had gathered.
sentences.zh: 这群人带着他们收集到的证据回到了埃德蒙顿警察局。

sentences.en: Realising the circumstances of his alleged departure didn't add up, police opened a missing persons file for Johnny Altinger on Friday, October 17, 2008,
sentences.zh: 意识到他所谓离开的情况根本说不通后，警方于2008年10月17日星期五为约翰尼·奥尔廷格立案失踪人口，

sentences.en: one week after his last confirmed communications.
sentences.zh: 距离他最后一次被确定的联系已经过去了一周。

sentences.en: A search for his car at the airport came up dry, and his name was absent from the passenger lists of all departing international flights.
sentences.zh: 在机场搜寻他的汽车一无所获，所有离境国际航班的乘客名单中也没有他的名字。

sentences.en: The detailed instructions
sentences.zh: 那份详细的指南

sentences.en: Jen emailed Johnny for their first date provided the strongest lead.
sentences.zh: 即珍发邮件给约翰尼让他们进行第一次约会的指南，提供了最重要的线索。

sentences.en: Detective Bill Clark was surprised to learn that Johnny had forwarded the instructions to two friends before going out, including Dale Smith,
sentences.zh: 比尔·克拉克警探惊讶地得知，约翰尼在出门前把这份指南转发给了两个朋友，其中包括戴尔·史密斯，

sentences.en: who recalled his friend saying something like, If anything happens to me, you'll know where to look.
sentences.zh: 他回忆起朋友当时说过类似这样的话：“如果我出了什么事，你们就知道去哪里找我。”

sentences.en: There were constant warnings to women on dating sites to exercise caution and to let someone know where they were going, but it was far less common for men to do so.
sentences.zh: 约会网站上经常警告女性要谨慎，并告知他人她们的去向，但男性这样做则要少得多。

sentences.en: The directions led detectives to a garage and a laneway in the residential area of Mill Woods in the city's southeaSt.
sentences.zh: 这些路线指引将警探们带到了该市东南部米尔伍兹住宅区的一个车库和一条后巷。

sentences.en: They arrived close to midnight, finding the building locked with a combination padlock.
sentences.zh: 他们近午夜时到达，发现建筑物的门锁上了密码挂锁。

sentences.en: The windows were covered up, but one constable peeked through a small hole and could see a light on inside.
sentences.zh: 窗户都被遮挡了，但一名警员透过一个小洞往里看，能看到里面亮着灯。

sentences.en: There didn't appear to be anyone in there and the interior was clean.
sentences.zh: 里面似乎没有人，而且内部很干净。

sentences.en: They knocked on the door to the adjoining house, but there was no answer.
sentences.zh: 他们敲了敲隔壁房子的门，但无人应答。

sentences.en: An application for a search warrant was denied as there was no evidence a crime had been committed.
sentences.zh: 由于没有证据表明发生了犯罪，搜查令的申请被驳回了。

sentences.en: However, police inquiries led to Kirkside Real Estate, who confirmed the garage had been leased to Mark Twitchell, an independent filmmaker.
sentences.zh: 然而，警方的调查锁定了柯克赛德房地产公司，该公司证实车库已出租给独立电影制作人马克·特维切尔。

sentences.en: On the evening of Saturday, October 18, police called Mark and told him there was a problem with the garage he was renting.
sentences.zh: 10月18日星期六晚上，警察打电话给马克，告诉他他租的车库出了点问题。

sentences.en: The director readily agreed to come and open it up.
sentences.zh: 这位导演痛快地答应过来打开车库。

sentences.en: At around 11.30pm, a maroon-coloured Pontiac Grand AM sedan pulled up outside the garage and Mark Twitchell emerged.
sentences.zh: 晚上11点半左右，一辆褐红色的庞蒂亚克大阿姆轿车停在车库外，马克·特维切尔从车里走了出来。

sentences.en: He was agitated as he had to pull over twice while on his way over to answer calls from Kirkside Real Estate, from which he surmised that someone
sentences.zh: 他情绪有些激动，因为在赶来接听柯克赛德房地产公司电话的途中，他不得不两次靠边停车，由此他推测有人

sentences.en: had been using the garage without his knowledge and left the lights on.
sentences.zh: 在他不知情的情况下使用了车库，还把灯开着。

sentences.en: As Mark went to let the police into the building, he expressed surprise at the padlock on the door, explaining it was different from the one he'd been using.
sentences.zh: 当马克去带警察进入建筑时，他对门上的挂锁感到惊讶，并解释说这和他一直在用的那个不一样。

sentences.en: His combination padlock was silver on the outside with a black plastic dial in the centre, but this one was pure metal.
sentences.zh: 他的密码挂锁外表是银色的，中心有一个黑色塑料拨盘，但这个是全金属的。

sentences.en: Mark said he didn't know the combination and allowed officers to break it off.
sentences.zh: 马克说他不知道密码，并允许警官将其砸断。

sentences.en: Mark explained that he rented the garage for $175 a month.
sentences.zh: 马克解释说，他租这个车库的费用是每月175美元。

sentences.en: The residential space was rented to temporary foreign workers while someone else lived in the basement.
sentences.zh: 居住区租给了临时外国劳工，而地下室则住着另一个人。

sentences.en: Mark didn't have any contact with the other people in the building.
sentences.zh: 马克与楼里的其他人没有任何接触。

sentences.en: As they entered the garage, a strong smell lingered inside, indicating something had recently been burned in there.
sentences.zh: 当他们进入车库时，里面弥漫着一股刺鼻的气味，表明不久前有人在里面烧过东西。

sentences.en: The odour emanated from an oil drum in one corner that had scorch marks and contained charred remains.
sentences.zh: 这股气味散发自角落里的一个油桶，油桶上有烧焦的痕迹，里面装着烧焦的残余物。

sentences.en: Mark said he ordered the barrel to use as a garbage can and it had not been scorched when he had last seen it.
sentences.zh: 马克说他订购这个桶是用来当垃圾桶的，他上次见到它时并没有被烧焦。

sentences.en: He also noted that several things were out of place.
sentences.zh: 他还指出有几样东西摆放得不对劲。

sentences.en: Most of his roll of duct tape had been used, all his garbage bags were gone and an unopened bottle of cleaner was now half empty.
sentences.zh: 他大部分的电工胶带都用完了，所有的垃圾袋都不见了，一瓶未开封的清洁剂现在也少了一半。

sentences.en: All the windows were covered from the inside and when the roller doors were closed, it was impossible to see in.
sentences.zh: 所有的窗户都从里面遮挡住了，当卷帘门关上时，从外面根本看不到里面。

sentences.en: Mark explained that in late September he had filmed a scene for his short psychological thriller about a serial killer titled House of Cards.
sentences.zh: 马克解释说，在9月下旬，他为自己的短篇心理惊悚片（关于一个连环杀手，名为《纸牌屋》）拍摄了一个场景。

sentences.en: As it occurred at night time, he had to block out the daylight that poured into the building.
sentences.zh: 由于场景发生在夜间，他必须挡住倾泻进建筑物的日光。

sentences.en: There were a few red spatters about the garage, which Mark clarified were remnants of fake blood.
sentences.zh: 车库里有一些红色的溅痕，马克澄清说是假血的残留物。

sentences.en: The attending officers decided to call their staff sergeant and while waiting,
sentences.zh: 出警的警官决定打电话给他们的值班警长，在等待期间，

sentences.en: Mark Twitchell chatted with Constable Christopher Maxwell in a police car preparing his written statement.
sentences.zh: 马克·特维切尔在一辆警车里与克里斯托弗·麦克斯韦警员闲聊，同时准备他的书面供词。

sentences.en: It was a pleasant conversation, mostly centred on Mark's filmmaking and interest in the Star Wars movie franchise.
sentences.zh: 这是一次愉快的交谈，主要围绕马克的电影创作以及他对《星球大战》电影系列的兴趣。

sentences.en: When asked if he would be willing to come back to the station to answer some questions,
sentences.zh: 当被问及是否愿意回警局回答一些问题时，

sentences.en: Mark agreed.
sentences.zh: 马克爽快地答应了。

sentences.en: It was around 3.30am when Detective Mike Tabler interviewed Mark Twitchell.
sentences.zh: 大约凌晨3点30分，迈克·泰伯探员对马克·特维切尔进行了讯问。

sentences.en: He was forthcoming and helpful, though seemed more interested in talking about his film career.
sentences.zh: 他坦率而乐于助人，尽管似乎对谈论自己的电影生涯更感兴趣。

sentences.en: He shared how he'd lined up A-list actors and the co-producer who worked on the 2001 heist film Ocean's Eleven for an upcoming comedy
sentences.zh: 他分享了自己如何为即将上映的一部喜剧争取到了一线演员以及曾参与2001年劫案电影《十一罗汉》的联合制片人，

sentences.en: and discussed his plans to submit House of Cards to festivals or pitch it to investors in the hopes they would fund a feature-length version or television series.
sentences.zh: 并讨论了他的计划：将《纸牌屋》送去电影节参展，或者向投资者推销，希望他们能资助拍摄长片版或电视剧。

sentences.en: He described the scene in the garage, detailing how the production crew had made large quantities of fake blood using corn syrup and food dye,
sentences.zh: 他描述了车库里的场景，详细说明了制作团队如何用玉米糖浆和食用色素制作大量的假血，

sentences.en: creating a realistic but messy result.
sentences.zh: 创造出逼真但凌乱的效果。

sentences.en: Detective Tabler pointed out the coincidence that Mark was filming a serial killer movie in the very place a man had disappeared from.
sentences.zh: 泰伯探员指出一个巧合：马克竟然在一个男人失踪的地方拍摄一部连环杀手电影。

sentences.en: Mark agreed, stating,
sentences.zh: 马克表示同意，并说道，

sentences.en: Mark provided a list of people who had worked on House of Cards and others who had accessed the garage.
sentences.zh: 马克提供了一份曾参与《纸牌屋》拍摄的人员名单以及其他曾进入车库的人员名单。

sentences.en: He said the last time he had been there was Friday October 10, the day Johnny Altinger's friends last confirmed contact with the missing man.
sentences.zh: 他说他最后一次去那里是10月10日星期五，也就是强尼·阿尔廷格的朋友最后一次确认与这名失踪男子取得联系的日子。

sentences.en: When asked if he knew of someone called Johnny Altinger,
sentences.zh: 当被问及是否认识一个叫强尼·阿尔廷格的人时，

sentences.en: Mark was certain he had never heard the name.
sentences.zh: 马克确信自己从未听说过这个名字。

sentences.en: The detective provided details about Johnny's last known activity and how he had gone to the garage to meet Jen, but instead encountered a man working on a film.
sentences.zh: 探员提供了强尼最后的已知活动细节，以及他是如何去车库见简，却遇到一个在拍电影的人的。

sentences.en: Mark appeared baffled, claiming not to know anybody by the name of Jen.
sentences.zh: 马克显得很困惑，声称不认识任何叫简的人。

sentences.en: A rudimentary background check revealed that Mark Twitchell came from a good home and had no history of violence or criminality, although there was an old bankruptcy
sentences.zh: 一份初步的背景调查显示，马克·特维切尔来自一个好家庭，没有暴力或犯罪记录，尽管有一桩旧破产案

sentences.en: that would soon be discharged.
sentences.zh: 很快就会解除。

sentences.en: After the lengthy interview,
sentences.zh: 经过长时间的讯问后，

sentences.en: Mark was released with instructions to contact police if he recalled anything that may assist in their search for Johnny Altinger.
sentences.zh: 马克获释了，并被嘱咐如果想起任何可能协助寻找强尼·阿尔廷格的信息，要与警方联系。

sentences.en: Casefile will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: 档案室节目稍后回归。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的赞助商广告来支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Casefile to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您就是在支持档案室继续为您带来优质内容。

sentences.en: The next day,
sentences.zh: 第二天，

sentences.en: Detective Tabler received a three-page email from Mark Twitchell in which he recalled several strange occurrences he believed might be related to their investigation.
sentences.zh: 泰伯探员收到了马克·特维切尔发来的一封三页纸的电子邮件，他在信中回忆了几件他认为可能与他们的调查有关的奇怪事情。

sentences.en: Weeks earlier,
sentences.zh: 几周前，

sentences.en: Mark's car was broken into while he was at a show with a friend named Joss, who had worked odd production jobs on House of Cards and designed the film's website.
sentences.zh: 马克的车被砸了，当时他和一位名叫乔斯的朋克去看演出，乔斯曾在《纸牌屋》中做过零散的制作工作，并设计了该片的网站。

sentences.en: The offender stole Mark's sunglasses, the loose cash kept in the cup holder, and a bunch of receipts.
sentences.zh: 罪犯偷走了马克的太阳镜、放在杯托里的零钱以及一堆收据。

sentences.en: One was for financial services company Western Union and featured Mark's residential address, while two others related to the garage and listed its address.
sentences.zh: 其中一张是金融服务公司西联汇款的收据，上面有马克的住宅地址，另外两张与车库有关，上面列出了车库的地址。

sentences.en: Then, on the night of Sunday October 12,
sentences.zh: 然后，在10月12日星期日晚上，

sentences.en: Mark returned home after visiting his in-laws to find the front door to his home unlocked.
sentences.zh: 马克探亲回来后，发现家里的前门没锁。

sentences.en: He didn't notice anything missing or any signs of an intruder, and chalked it up to paranoia and fatigue.
sentences.zh: 他没有发现任何东西丢失或有闯入的迹象，便把这归咎于多疑和疲劳。

sentences.en: On Wednesday October 15,
sentences.zh: 10月15日星期三，

sentences.en: Mark had just driven to a petrol station to fill up a jerry can and had pulled over to answer a call when a stranger tapped on his window.
sentences.zh: 马克刚刚开车去加油站给一个备用油桶加油，并把车停在路边接电话，这时一个陌生人敲了他的车窗。

sentences.en: The Caucasian man was around 6 feet 2 inches tall, medium build, with black mid-length hair.
sentences.zh: 这个白人男子身高约6英尺2英寸，中等身材，留着黑色中长发。

sentences.en: Mark rolled down his window, and the man asked if he'd like to buy his car, a red Mazda 323, as he was set to receive a brand new BMW from a sugar mama he had hooked up with.
sentences.zh: 马克摇下车窗，这名男子问他想不想买他的车，一辆红色的马自达323，因为他即将从他勾搭上的一个富婆那里得到一辆崭新的宝马。

sentences.en: The man wanted to get rid of his Mazda before taking off on an all-expenses-paid vacation and offered to sell it to Mark for whatever cash he had on him.
sentences.zh: 这名男子想在进行全包度假前脱手他的马自达，并主动提出以他身上所有的现金将车卖给马克。

sentences.en: Mark replied that he only had $40 and was surprised when the man accepted the small payment.
sentences.zh: 马克回答说他只有40美元，当这名男子接受了这么少的一笔钱时，他感到很惊讶。

sentences.en: Although suspicious,
sentences.zh: 尽管有所怀疑，

sentences.en: Mark permitted the man to follow him to the garage.
sentences.zh: 马克还是允许这名男子跟着他来到车库。

sentences.en: He described in the email to Detective Tabla, quote,
sentences.zh: 他在给泰伯探员的电子邮件中描述道，引述：

sentences.en: His even-kill disposition all but disappeared when we got to the garage, and I was getting a weird vibe from him.
sentences.zh: 我们一到车库，他那平静的脾气几乎消失得无影无踪，我从他身上感受到了一种诡异的气场。

sentences.en: The man was obviously keen to get going, handing Mark the Mazda's keys, registration and insurance before taking off.
sentences.zh: 这名男子显然急着离开，把马自达的钥匙、登记证和保险单交给了马克，然后就跑了。

sentences.en: Mark quickly realised the car had a manual transmission, which he didn't know how to operate, and had his friend Joss collect the Mazda and store it.
sentences.zh: 马克很快意识到这辆车是手动挡的，而他不会开，于是让他的朋友乔斯把马自达开走并存放起来。

sentences.en: Mark finished up his email, writing,
sentences.zh: 马克写完了他的电子邮件，写道：

sentences.en: I don't mind saying this is all seriously stressing me out.
sentences.zh: 我不介意直说，这一切真的让我压力山大。

sentences.en: Identity theft is the first concern, my home being compromised is now another one, and we're strongly considering getting an active security system installed next week.

sentences.en: SK Confessions, as a homage to horror and supernatural fiction author Stephen King.
sentences.zh: 《杀人狂自白》，以此向恐怖和超自然小说作家斯蒂芬·金致敬。

sentences.en: The third step would be to harness social media, creating posts from people who would allege to have almost been a victim of the hockey mask killer themselves.
sentences.zh: 第三步是利用社交媒体，发布一些自称差点成为曲棍球面具杀手受害者的发帖。

sentences.en: Using a photo of a woman he had stolen from another
sentences.zh: 利用从另一个

sentences.en: Plenty of Fish profile, Mark searched for someone to serve this purpose, and found Gilles Tetreault.
sentences.zh: Plenty of Fish资料上盗取的一个女人的照片，马克寻找能达到这个目的的人，并找到了吉尔·特雷特。

sentences.en: Mark arranged a time for him to come to the garage, which he designed to resemble a kill room, to provide the desired effect.
sentences.zh: 马克安排了一个时间让他来到车库，他将车库设计得像一个杀戮间，以达到预期的效果。

sentences.en: He said he planned to fill Gilles in on his elaborate plan, but decided to switch it up by genuinely scaring him into thinking he was about to be murdered.
sentences.zh: 他说他本来打算把自己的详细计划向吉尔和盘托出，但后来改变了主意，决定通过真切地吓唬对方，让吉尔以为自己快被谋杀了。

sentences.en: He donned the hockey mask and used the stun baton, claiming he knew the implement would not cause significant harm.
sentences.zh: 他戴上曲棍球面具，用上了电击警棍，并声称他知道这个工具不会造成重伤。

sentences.en: The plan was always to let Gilles go, so that when the
sentences.zh: 这个计划本来就是要放吉尔走，这样一来，当

sentences.en: House of Cards movie and book were released, his experience with the hockey mask killer would be convincing.
sentences.zh: 《纸牌屋》的电影和书发行时，他与曲棍球面具杀手的经历就会显得十分逼真。

sentences.en: Mark said he kept the mask, hoodie, baton and handcuffs because he figured it would be best to come clean if Gilles did report what had happened.
sentences.zh: 马克说他保留了面具、连帽衫、警棍和手铐，因为他盘算着万一吉尔真的报警了，自己坦白交代或许是最好的选择。

sentences.en: The following week, he used the name Jen and scheduled a date with his next target, Johnny Altinger.
sentences.zh: 第二周，他化名珍，和下一个目标约翰·阿尔廷格（Johnny Altinger）约好了见面时间。

sentences.en: Mark arrived at the garage at around 6pm on Friday October 10, 2008, using his laptop to continue messaging Johnny, who showed up earlier than expected.
sentences.zh: 2008年10月10日星期五傍晚6点左右，马克来到了那个车库，他用笔记本电脑继续给约翰发消息，而约翰比预期得更早赶到了。

sentences.en: Mark threw up the smokescreen that Jen was stuck in traffic and wouldn't be able to make it for at least 30 minutes, so Johnny left.
sentences.zh: 马克释放烟雾弹，谎称珍被堵在路上，至少得过30分钟才能赶到，于是约翰便离开了。

sentences.en: He wondered whether he should reveal the truth to Johnny over email or in person, and ultimately invited him back, still posing as Jen.
sentences.zh: 他琢磨着是通过电子邮件还是当面把真相告诉约翰，最终他还是以珍的名义邀请约翰折返回来。

sentences.en: When Johnny returned, Mark informed him that there was no Jen and tried to explain his psychosis layering idea.
sentences.zh: 当约翰返回时，马克告知他根本没有什么珍，并试图解释他那套心理战叠加的构想。

sentences.en: Johnny was unhappy at having been duped and the two got into an argument.
sentences.zh: 约翰因为被耍而感到很不高兴，两人随即发生了争吵。

sentences.en: Mark claimed that as he turned, Johnny kicked him in the lower back before grabbing a pipe and swinging it at him.
sentences.zh: 马克声称，就在他转身时，约翰踢了他的下背部，接着抓起一根管子向他挥舞过来。

sentences.en: Mark dodged the first couple of swings, but the third came down on his elbow.
sentences.zh: 马克躲开了前两下挥击，但第三下结结实实地砸在了他的手肘上。

sentences.en: He wrestled the pipe from Johnny and hit him on the top of the head with it.
sentences.zh: 他从约翰手中抢过管子，并用它猛击了约翰的头顶。

sentences.en: As the fight continued, Mark grabbed a knife hoping Johnny would back off.
sentences.zh: 随着争斗继续，马克抓起了一把刀，希望约翰能知难而退。

sentences.en: Instead, he rushed forward and Mark stabbed him.
sentences.zh: 然而约翰非但没退，反而猛冲过来，马克便刺中了他。

sentences.en: It was just the sickest feeling ever.
sentences.zh: 那真是有生以来最令人作呕的感觉。

sentences.en: I just started to feel this wet sensation around the hand still holding the handle and I let go instinctively, and then I saw it sticking out of him.
sentences.zh: 我刚开始感觉到握着刀柄的那只手周围湿漉漉的，便本能地松开了手，接着我看到刀插在他的身上。

sentences.en: Upon realising Johnny was dying, Mark said,
sentences.zh: 在意识到约翰快要死了的时候，马克说，

sentences.en: Mark said he panicked and decided to use his film set to,
sentences.zh: 马克说他当时慌了手脚，决定利用他的电影布景来，

sentences.en: From this point on, he agreed that the dismemberment, failed cremation and disposal of Johnny's body, as well as using his social media and email accounts to cover up his crime,
sentences.zh: 从这一刻起，他承认尸体被分尸、焚尸未遂并被抛弃，以及利用其社交媒体和电子邮箱账号来掩盖罪行等一系列行为，

sentences.en: had occurred as written in SK Confessions.
sentences.zh: 都如《杀手忏悔录》中所写的那样发生了。

sentences.en: However, he said the feelings described when cutting up the body were exactly the opposite of the truth.
sentences.zh: 然而，他说切碎尸体时所描述的那些感受与事实恰好相反。

sentences.en: He felt weaker, not stronger, like he was carrying a heavy burden he would never be able to share.
sentences.zh: 他感觉到的不是变得强大，而是更加虚弱，仿佛背负着一个永远无法与人分享的沉重包袱。

sentences.en: As for the messages, Mark sent his Facebook friend Renee four days after Johnny's murder, in which he wrote,
sentences.zh: 至于那些信息，是马克在约翰遇害四天后发给他的脸书好友蕾妮的，他在其中写道：

sentences.en: Suffice it to say, I crossed the line on Friday and I liked it.
sentences.zh: 套用一句话说，我星期五越界了，而且我还挺喜欢这种感觉。

sentences.en: He insisted this was in reference to his affair with ex-girlfriend Tracy.
sentences.zh: 他坚称这指的是他与前女友特雷西的私情。

sentences.en: In summary, Mark's attorney maintained that Johnny's death was accidental and in self-defence,
sentences.zh: 总而言之，马克的辩护律师坚称约翰的死是一场意外，且属于正当防卫，

sentences.en: adding that SK Confessions was a work of fiction, or at best, a fictionalised version of real events.
sentences.zh: 并补充说《杀手忏悔录》是一部虚构作品，或者充其量只是对真实事件进行艺术加工的版本。

sentences.en: The prosecution pointed out that Mark Twitchell's entire life was built on fantasy and lies, and that his testimony should be taken with a grain of salt.
sentences.zh: 控方指出，马克·特维切尔的一生完全建立在幻想和谎言之上，他的证词应当大打折扣。

sentences.en: He lied to his wife, his girlfriend and friends, as well as Gilles, Johnny and the police.
sentences.zh: 他对妻子、女友和朋友撒谎，也对吉尔、约翰以及警方撒谎。

sentences.en: The prosecutor remarked that Mark's assertions that he only aimed to recruit strangers to help create an online urban legend were as ridiculous as the story about the $40 Mazda.
sentences.zh: 主控检察官评论称，马克声称自己招募陌生人只是为了帮他在网上打造都市传说的说法，荒谬程度不亚于那个关于40美元马自达汽车的故事。

sentences.en: On Tuesday April 12, 2011, the jury found Mark Twitchell guilty of the first-degree murder of Johnny Altinger.
sentences.zh: 2011年4月12日星期二，陪审团裁定马克·特维切尔谋杀约翰·阿尔廷格的一级谋杀罪名成立。

sentences.en: In her victim impact statement, Johnny's mother, Elfrieda, explained that Johnny's telephone company hadn't yet reassigned his number,
sentences.zh: 约翰的母亲埃尔弗里达在受害人影响陈述中解释说，约翰的电信公司当时还没有注销他的号码，

sentences.en: so she constantly rang it just to hear his voicemail greeting.
sentences.zh: 所以她经常拨打这个号码，只为了听听他的语音信箱留言。

sentences.en: Quote,
sentences.zh: 原话是：

sentences.en: He was a pure joy as a child.
sentences.zh: 他小时候是个纯粹的开心果。

sentences.en: It was an amazing journey watching him grow in every way and make his way through life.
sentences.zh: 看着他方方面面地成长并一路走过人生，这是一段奇妙的旅程。

sentences.en: There are no words to describe the pain and feelings of horror one goes through.
sentences.zh: 没有任何言语可以形容一个人所经历的痛苦和惊恐之情。

sentences.en: I can't imagine the fear, desperation and pain Johnny must have endured.
sentences.zh: 我无法想象约翰当时一定承受了多么巨大的恐惧、绝望和痛苦。

sentences.en: As a mother, I feel I can't think about it without going over the edge.
sentences.zh: 作为一个母亲，我觉得自己只要一去想这些就会彻底崩溃。

sentences.en: There is no joy in life.
sentences.zh: 生活中已经没有快乐可言。

sentences.en: It has been ripped away from me.
sentences.zh: 这一切都被无情地从我身边夺走了。

sentences.en: I fear this nightmare and my grief will continue until my dying day.
sentences.zh: 我担心这场噩梦和我的悲痛将一直持续到我生命的最后一天。

sentences.en: People have asked me if I wish there was still the death penalty and I must answer no.
sentences.zh: 有人问我是否希望现在仍有死刑，我的回答是没有。

sentences.en: My wish is for the perpetrator of this unforgivable and horrific act to reflect on his actions and die a slow death every day of his life.
sentences.zh: 我的愿望是让这个不可饶恕的恐怖行径的施暴者反思他的所作所为，并且在余生的每一天都备受折磨、缓慢死去。

sentences.en: In his statement, Gary Altinger wrote,
sentences.zh: 加里·阿尔廷格在陈述中写道：

sentences.en: Mark Twitchell was sentenced to life in prison with a minimum of 25 years.
sentences.zh: 马克·特维切尔被判处终身监禁，且至少25年不得假释。

sentences.en: Following the trial, Gary told the media of the grief his family had been exposed to over the
sentences.zh: 庭审结束后，加里向媒体讲述了过去几周乃至数年里

sentences.en: previous weeks and years, stating that it was something no human being should ever feel.
sentences.zh: 他的家人所承受的悲痛，并表示这是任何人类都不应该感受到的。

sentences.en: Alfredo added that although there will never be closure, quote,
sentences.zh: 阿尔弗里达补充说，尽管痛苦永远无法真正画上句号，但引述原话：

sentences.en: We will move on to the next step, I think.
sentences.zh: 我想，我们要迈向下一步了。

sentences.en: Start to heal.
sentences.zh: 开始疗伤。

sentences.en: If that's possible.
sentences.zh: 如果这还可能的话。

sentences.en: Mark Twitchell attempted to appeal his conviction on the grounds that extensive media coverage ruined any opportunity for a fair trial, but the appeal was abandoned in 2012.
sentences.zh: 马克·特维切尔曾试图以密集的媒体报道剥夺了其获得公正审判的机会为由对定罪提起上诉，但该上诉于2012年被撤回。

sentences.en: In May 2013, it was reported that Mark had purchased a television for his prison cell,
sentences.zh: 2013年5月，据报道马克为自己的牢房买了一台电视，

sentences.en: which he used to catch up on every episode of Dexter that he had missed since his incarceration.
sentences.zh: 他用这台电视补看完了自入狱以来错过的每一集《嗜血法医》。

sentences.en: Detective Mark Anstey believed the precautions taken by Johnny Altinger prior to his date with Jen had ultimately saved others.
sentences.zh: 警探马克·安斯蒂认为，约翰·阿尔廷格在赴珍的约会前所采取的防范措施最终拯救了其他人。

sentences.en: By sharing his plans and whereabouts with friends and emailing them the directions to the garage, he enabled police to swiftly identify Mark Twitchell as their prime suspect,
sentences.zh: 通过与朋友分享他的计划和行踪，并向他们发邮件告知车库的路线，他使警方得以迅速锁定马克·特维切尔为头号嫌疑人，

sentences.en: ensuring he didn't have an opportunity to claim more victiMs.
sentences.zh: 从而确保了他没有机会再害更多受害者。

sentences.en: Detective Anstey told Johnny's mother,
sentences.zh: 安斯蒂警探对约翰的母亲说：

sentences.en: Your son, in a roundabout way, was a hero.
sentences.zh: 从某种意义上说，你的儿子是个英雄。

sentences.en: He definitely saved a lot of grief for other families.
sentences.zh: 他绝对为其他许多家庭免去了许多悲痛。
